metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: RIYTAY crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C48 H174 Cu24 Gd6 N12 O96 12+,11(Cl1 O4 1-),19(H2 O1),Cl1 1-. From the CIF bond table, Gd1 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd3 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Cu1 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu4 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu6 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu8 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu10 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu12 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu3 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu7 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu2 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu9 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu5 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu11 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Gd4 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd5 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd6 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Cu13 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu14 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu15 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu16 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu17 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu18 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu19 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu20 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu21 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu22 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu23 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors; Cu24 (Cu) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 66 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.008-3.547 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 72.81-121.07°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Gd6Cu24(Ac)6(L-Al)12(μ3-OH)30(μ2-OH)6Cl(H2O)24]·(ClO4)11·(H2O)19. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 30 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 μ2-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 24 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 19 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
